messages.text_fr: Norris, Antonelli, Russell à Interlagos : mon podium est bouclé. Toi, t'oses faire mieux ? 🏁
messages.text_en: Norris, Antonelli, Russell at Interlagos: my podium is locked. Think you can do better? 🏁

messages.text_en: In Brazil, I nail it. Beat the AI if you can, or watch my picks from down below.
